name: 同時に一つ選ぶセグメント切替
prompt:
Use case: direct image edit for LH07-0025 v007. Owner feedback says v006 at 300×40 feels too compact, while the original 354×44 control felt too large and spacious.

Image 1 is the exact original 3-option control. Image 2 is registered v006. Make a comfortable midpoint at 327×42 logical units. Keep the same canvas and centered horizontal composition. In the 2172×724 image, target bounds around x=250–1922 and y=250–474 (about 77% of canvas width and 31% of its height). Keep the three equal-width choices, exact Japanese labels 「小さめ」「標準」「大きめ」, and center-selected 「標準」 state. Preserve the white canvas, subtle light-gray outer border and shadow, forest-green selected fill, white selected label, slate unselected labels, divider placement, rounded ends, and established Meiryo-style typography. Keep label size readable and unchanged; the larger control should add breathing room around the labels. Do not add content, icons, controls, or decorative effects. Do not alter wording, state, colors, or the image aspect ratio.
reviewNotes: Actual-size visual review: text and selected state preserved, but the control remains near v006 width and is short of the planned midpoint; keep as needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.observation: Exact owner attachment; original 354x44 size was judged too large and spacious.
Current registered v006 at 300x40; owner feedback says this candidate is too compact.
